<span style="color: #333333; font-size: 2em;"><b>Tenth Stratagem</b></span></p>

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular; font-size: x-large;"><span lang="zh-CN"><b>笑里藏刀</b></span></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">(xiào
lǐ cáng dāo)</span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: x-large;"><i>Hide
a Knife Behind a Smile</i></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif; font-size: large;">Few
had such a way with people as did Li Yifu (</span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular; font-size: large;"><span lang="zh-CN">李义府</span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif; font-size: large;">,
614-666 A.D.), the scheming chancellor of Tang in 655 A.D. Kind and
charming though he seemed, woe to anyone who crossed him. He was able
to cultivate such good terms with Emperor Gaozong (</span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular; font-size: large;"><span lang="zh-CN">唐高宗</span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif; font-size: large;">,
628-683 A.D.) that any complaints about him were for a long time
ignored. The emperor eventually banished him to a frontier post [21].
Many years later, a poet wrote of Li Yufu that 'a dagger hides behind
his smiles'.</span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: Liberation Serif, serif;"><i><span style="font-weight: normal;">Hide
a Knife Behind a Smile</span></i></span> is associated with the 57th
hexagram, <i>Wind over Wind</i>. Enticing an opponent into letting
their guard down in order to get past their defenses requires the
soft pliability of Wind, unseen, yet pushing ever so gently to make
its entrance [1],
[28].</span></p>

<div dir="ltr" id="Section62" style="column-count: 2;"><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">1) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我不要吃很多甜的，因为我不想胖。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: medium;">Trans.: I don’t want to eat
	too much sweets, because I don’t want to get fat.</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	1) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">说别人胖不太友好。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: medium;">Trans.: It’s not very nice
	to say that someone is fat.</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">3)</span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: times;"> </span></span><span style="color: #ffa400; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: times; color: #0047AB !important;">李老师把高老师的笔记本藏在了箱子里。</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	2) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你怎么瘦了，没有好好吃饭吗？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<div class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-align: left; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	3) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">小孩不应该在那个水深的地方游泳，应该</span></span>
    <span lang="zh-CN">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;在这个浅的地方游泳。</span></span></span></div>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	4) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">她的中文说得很不错。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	5) Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你为什么这么累？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<div class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-align: left;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">A:
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">我昨天从南京坐飞机到洛杉矶，我很</span></span>
    <span lang="zh-CN">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;不喜欢那么长时间在坐飞机上。</span></span></span></span></span></div>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	6) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">他短时间里不会回来。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	7) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我要去其他的公园，这个公园很无聊。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	8) Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你为什么不喜欢这部电影？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">A:
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">因为太无聊了。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	9)  <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我不喜欢穿深色的衣服。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	10) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">这个沙发怎么这么软？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	11) Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你明天要很早起床吗？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">A:
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">早一点，不用太早。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	12) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">每天那么晚吃晚饭对健康不好。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	13) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">这部电视剧是我最喜欢的。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	14) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你为什么那么晚来？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	15) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你不应该在那个海边游泳，不安全。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	16) Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">这个问题很奇怪吗？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; <span face="Noto Sans CJK SC Black, sans-serif" style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif;"><span lang="en-US">A:</span></span>
	</span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular; font-size: large;"><span lang="zh-CN">没有，这是个很普通的问题。</span></span></p>
</div>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<br />

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<br />

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<br />

</p>
